title: Tridactyl beings of Peru from the Nazca period
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Tridactyl beings of Peru from the Nazca period, about Nazca period; 2017-2020s analysis at Nazca, Peru, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about "tridactyl beings", meaning three-fingered bodies, from Peru, which he says date from the Nazca period, an ancient era in a region full of cave art. Citing the work of a man named Jaime Maussan, Michels says that one of the people doing genetic analysis on the bodies found a mutation matching a human mutation that changes the number of fingers. If true, it would tie these strange bodies to real biology rather than to sculpture.
